purpose: Executable-facing contract cards for every active hero and ability.

needle.fantasy: Spore controller who turns a lane into a costly route and can escape through his own cloud.
needle.winCondition: Keep enemies inside spore pressure, deny healing, then pull them into the root zone or disengage through the cloud.
needle.counterplay: Break line of sight, leave the root telegraph, respect anti-heal and punish Needle after the escape is spent.
needle.soloAcceptance: Needle wins through space and attrition; a missed root or wasted cloud does not create free damage.
needle.teamAcceptance: Needle enables allied focus and route denial without replacing the team's finishing damage.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Needle holds the approach with spore pressure and cloud escape.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze can disengage after a missed root without taking free damage.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Needle converts cover and route denial into a close-range setup window.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Brock remains favored in clean open sightlines.

basic.impact: The spore projectile applies anti-heal on contact and blooms into a bounded six-spore impact.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent; a bloom may finish at range but no enemy receives anti-heal without contact.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before projectile release cancels the shot.

super.impact: The root telegraph pulls enemies once on impact and leaves a damaging slow zone.
super.missOutcome: The selected zone is consumed and expires without damage or pull when no enemy is inside it.
super.interrupt: Stun before the telegraph completes cancels deployment; after impact the zone remains until expiry.

gadget.impact: Needle dashes through valid space and leaves a slowing spore cloud that can build a root response.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and the dash/cloud resolve without dealing damage when no enemy enters the cloud.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before dash activation rejects the gadget; active cloud remains independent of the caster.

mandy.fantasy: Close-range fighter who converts a committed stance into a staff payoff or a map-wide wave.
mandy.winCondition: Hold the correct distance, build focus with staff strikes, then commit to the wave while surviving its preparation.
mandy.counterplay: Keep outside the staff cone, interrupt or leave the wave telegraph, and punish Mandy after her defensive window ends.
mandy.soloAcceptance: Mandy wins a committed close trade but cannot delete a full-health target through missed swings alone.
mandy.teamAcceptance: Mandy creates a front-line threat and wall break, while allies still need to capitalize on the stun window.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mandy wins the committed close trade after crossing the ranged threat.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Brock can keep distance and punish the visible wave wind-up.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mandy's stance and health budget let her contest the first assassin entry.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze wins if Mandy wastes stance before the entry.

basic.impact: A staff cone deals melee damage and gains the focus modifier only when Mandy maintains the intended stance.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and focus is not rewarded when the cone misses every enemy.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before the active frame cancels the swing.

super.impact: After a visible charge, a wall-breaking wave travels through the line and applies damage and stun once per target.
super.missOutcome: The wave is consumed after release but deals no damage or stun when no target intersects its line.
super.interrupt: Stun before release cancels the charge; after release the wave resolves independently.

gadget.impact: Mandy gains a short damage-reduction stance and arms one empowered staff strike.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and the defensive window expires without a bonus strike if Mandy never connects.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the stance; the active timer does not grant immunity.

fairy-mina.fantasy: Star support who converts accurate volleys into sustain and protects a nearby ally with a cocoon.
fairy-mina.winCondition: Stay near the fight edge, land star volleys, preserve an ally through the cocoon and punish marked enemies.
fairy-mina.counterplay: Dodge the fan, split from the aura, pressure Mina outside her support range and punish her low solo burst.
fairy-mina.soloAcceptance: Mina survives and wins through sustain and spacing, not by out-bursting a fighter at point blank.
fairy-mina.teamAcceptance: Mina's value is visible in ally survival and healing windows; her support does not become team-wide immortality.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mina survives the first dive with cocoon and repelling wave while preserving spacing.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze can wait out the defensive window and re-enter after the peel is spent.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mina preserves an ally through the tank's long contact window.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Mico wins space when Mina is isolated outside support range.

basic.impact: A three-star fan deals 40 damage per star and returns a bounded self-heal on successful contact, with a marked-target payoff.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and no healing, mark or detonation is granted without a valid hit.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before the fan becomes active cancels the volley.

super.impact: Mina receives a bounded shield and a visible aura that heals Mina while damaging enemies inside it.
super.missOutcome: The cocoon is consumed with no enemy damage when opponents leave the aura; Mina's defensive benefit remains time-limited.
super.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the cocoon; the active aura ends at its timer.

gadget.impact: A short radial wave knocks enemies away, deals bounded damage and clears Mina's negative statuses.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and Mina is cleansed even when no enemy is inside the wave.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before the wave becomes active rejects the gadget; it never creates an untelegraphed remote hit.

brock-zeus.fantasy: Long-range sharpshooter who trades mobility for predictable lightning lanes and delayed area strikes.
brock-zeus.winCondition: Create distance, land clean lightning shots and layer the delayed hammer strikes over the enemy's escape route.
brock-zeus.counterplay: Close the gap, use cover against the line, watch the strike reticles and punish Brock during the delayed commitment.
brock-zeus.soloAcceptance: Brock has the highest clean-range threat but loses a direct close trade when his telegraphs are dodged.
brock-zeus.teamAcceptance: Brock supplies ranged pressure and wall control without becoming a safe all-purpose finisher.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Brock wins the open-range poke if the reticles and projectile connect.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze must cross cover and punish Brock during delayed Super recovery.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Brock converts longer sightlines into higher immediate threat than a controller.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Needle can break sightline and win the route-denial exchange.

basic.impact: A readable lightning projectile deals one direct hit and a bounded splash at its impact point.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and no splash occurs when the projectile misses all valid targets.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before release cancels the projectile.

super.impact: Three reticled strikes land at fixed absolute times, each dealing bounded damage and breaking walls.
super.missOutcome: The strike sequence is consumed without damage or slow when all reticles are vacated before impact.
super.interrupt: Stun before the first strike cancels the sequence; after the first impact remaining strikes keep their authored timings.

gadget.impact: The next basic release becomes a piercing directional beam that can break walls along its line.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and the empowered shot is lost if the next release misses every target.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before arming rejects the gadget; an armed shot remains a single punishable commitment.

wukong-mico.fantasy: Durable staff tank who builds rage through contact and turns it into a disruptive vortex.
wukong-mico.winCondition: Occupy a contested lane, build rage with staff hits and force enemies to disengage from the vortex or armor window.
wukong-mico.counterplay: Kite the short cone, avoid feeding rage, leave the vortex telegraph and punish Mico after armor expires.
wukong-mico.soloAcceptance: Mico wins space and long trades but cannot reliably reach ranged targets without committing his limited movement tools.
wukong-mico.teamAcceptance: Mico anchors a team fight and creates peel space; his sustain is bounded and requires enemy proximity.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mico turns cover and armor into a successful close entry against the sharpshooter.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Brock wins if he keeps the gap and vacates the vortex telegraph.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Mico forces Mina away from her ally and contests the support's safe edge.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Mina wins the extended trade when Mico cannot reach her support range.

basic.impact: A heavy staff cone deals damage and grants one bounded rage charge per successful swing.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and no rage is granted when the swing hits no enemy.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before the active frame cancels the staff swing.

super.impact: Mico aims a short landing jump, then creates a visible self-centered vortex that pulls, stuns on entry and periodically damages enemies while restoring bounded health.
super.missOutcome: The vortex is consumed and Mico receives only its self effect when no enemy enters the zone.
super.interrupt: Stun before vortex activation cancels the jump; after activation the zone expires on its timer.

gadget.impact: Mico gains bounded damage reduction and stores incoming damage for one visible retaliatory burst.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and the armor expires without a burst if no damage is stored.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the armor; active armor never grants immunity or infinite sustain.

persephone-lumi.fantasy: Garden controller who plants persistent flowers and converts prepared space into a burst.
persephone-lumi.winCondition: Plant flowers along likely routes, use the garden to slow and reveal enemies, then detonate setup for a controlled burst and heal.
persephone-lumi.counterplay: Avoid planted zones, rotate before the delayed root trigger and force Lumi to spend her setup without a target.
persephone-lumi.soloAcceptance: Lumi controls routes and wins prepared fights, but direct unprepared trades remain punishable.
persephone-lumi.teamAcceptance: Lumi supplies area control and setup conversion for allies without stacking duplicate damage from overlapping objects.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Lumi prepares the route before Kaze commits and converts the dash lane into a root window.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze can rotate early and force Lumi to spend setup without contact.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Lumi wins a prepared choke through longer persistent control and reveal.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Katty can leave the garden telegraph and use flight to reset the zone exchange.

basic.impact: The flower projectile creates one bounded persistent zone on contact or at range end, with periodic damage and slow.
basic.missOutcome: The flower can bloom at range end, but no enemy receives damage or status without entering its zone.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before release cancels the projectile.

super.impact: A visible garden arms after the delay, stuns enemies once on activation and then applies a bounded slow zone.
super.missOutcome: The garden is consumed at the chosen point and deals no damage or status when enemies leave before activation.
super.interrupt: Stun before garden activation cancels deployment; after activation the zone remains until expiry.

gadget.impact: Lumi consumes her own flowers and garden once, applying one shared target burst and a bounded self-heal.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent with no damage or heal when Lumi has no active setup to consume.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before conversion rejects the gadget; consumed zones cannot be triggered a second time.

kaze.fantasy: Short-window execution assassin with a readable entry and a costly miss.
kaze.winCondition: Reach an isolated or weakened target, convert the dash into a combo finisher, then disengage before the reset window closes.
kaze.counterplay: Hold spacing, punish the missed dash, survive the first combo and deny the low-health execution.
kaze.soloAcceptance: A correct dash against a 30% HP target creates a kill window; a missed dash does not grant a free reset or immunity.
kaze.teamAcceptance: Kaze creates a focused pick without replacing a frontliner; the team can follow the entry but must cover the retreat.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Kaze reaches and executes a low-health sharpshooter through a committed dash.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Brock wins by maintaining range, using cover and dodging the dash line.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Kaze chooses the post-armor recovery window instead of trading into full safety.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Mico wins if Kaze enters before armor expires or misses the exit.

basic.impact: Two short slashes advance the combo; the third combo hit is the only empowered basic hit.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent, no combo progress is granted, and no reset is created.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before the active window cancels the slash.

super.impact: One hit per target during the dash; hit applies stun and primes the follow-up. Kill resets the super cooldown only.
super.missOutcome: The dash travels and the Super is consumed; no stun, prime or reset is awarded.
super.interrupt: Stun before dash activation cancels the cast; after activation the dash resolves once.

gadget.impact: Kaze becomes hidden and prepares one guaranteed critical first hit.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and stealth expires normally even if no target is found.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the cast; damage does not cancel the active stealth early.

katty.fantasy: Paint-based space controller who converts setup into zones and safe movement.
katty.winCondition: Layer paint in a contested route, force an enemy response, then use the zone or flight trail to close or escape.
katty.counterplay: Leave the painted zone during telegraph, avoid the third layer, and punish Katty when flight ends or a trail is wasted.
katty.soloAcceptance: Katty wins space through visible setup and a fair exit window; direct basic trading alone does not delete a full-health target.
katty.teamAcceptance: Katty creates a choke and enables a teammate's engage, but her zone does not replace allied damage or become unavoidable cover.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Katty layers a visible zone that makes a direct assassin entry costly.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Kaze can wait out the telegraph and punish Katty after flight ends.

benchmarkMatchups.expectedAdvantage: Katty controls the approach and converts a forced route into a paint stun.
benchmarkMatchups.counterplayMetric: Mandy wins by exiting the zone and re-engaging after the paint stack expires.

basic.impact: Short spray applies one paint layer; the third layer adds the stun and damage conversion.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and no paint layer is created outside the cone.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before active cancels the spray.

super.impact: The marked area applies a visible pull/slow and one paint conversion; damage starts after telegraph completion.
super.missOutcome: The zone is consumed at the selected point and can be left before impact; no target receives damage or status outside the area.
super.interrupt: Stun before deployment cancels the throw; after deployment the zone remains until expiry.

gadget.impact: Katty gains flight speed and leaves a readable trail; touching the trail detonates it once.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and flight ends without trail detonation if no enemy touches the trail.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the gadget; active flight ends at its timer and does not grant immunity.
